title: Roofing – Waterproofing (Hotmelt / Radmat)
activity: Hotmelt/Foamglas and torch-on warm roofs: prep, VCL, insulation, membranes, leak test
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Deck clean, dry, free from dust/laitance; outlets in and open?
Peel test done for adhesion to the concrete?
Primer fully covering, dried at least 24 hours, weather suitable?
Quality benchmark agreed for this area?
VCL fully adhered, no air bubbles; laps sealed?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – VCL; ITP 00006 2.3

questions.q: Galvanised upstands and tilt fillets installed at upstands as detailed?
Insulation the right board, laid black face up, broken bond, no gaps (Foamglas fully bonded where used)?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – insulation; ITP 00001 2.3

questions.q: Insulation adhesive beads at 300 mm centres (150 mm at perimeter)?
Underlay and cap sheet laps: side at least 80 mm, end at least 100 mm (150 mm where required)?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – Eshaflex laps

questions.q: Upstands, outlets and penetrations fully detailed, upstand boards the correct type?
questions.source: LDP roofing ITP 00006 checklist – upstand board; ITP 00006 2.5

questions.q: Electronic leak/integrity test passed before flagging or covering?
Membrane protected from following trades, no damage?
